must_have_options.name: Front Axle Lifting System
must_have_options.description: Essential for clearing curbs, speed bumps, and driveways. Without this, front carbon lip damage is almost guaranteed and resale liquidity drops by 40%.

must_have_options.name: Carbon Ceramic Brakes (CCB)
must_have_options.description: Standard equipment on LP610-4. Must verify rotor surface roughness and carbon oxidation. Replacement cost is $24,000+ for all 4 corners.

must_have_options.name: Magneto-rheological Suspension + Dynamic Steering (LDS)
must_have_options.description: Transforms ride quality from harsh track to daily compliant. Highly favored by second-hand buyers.

must_have_options.name: Transparent Engine Bonnet with Forged Composite Bay
must_have_options.description: Exposes the V10 engine. Cars with solid louvered black decklid sell at an immediate $5,000-$7,000 discount.

must_have_options.name: Sport / Race Exhaust System
must_have_options.description: Unlocks true V10 acoustic character. Factory sport exhaust or verified aftermarket (Akrapovic, Novitec, Capristo).

chronic_issues.symptoms: Oil seepage/droplets along the front axle casing and undertray. Requires differential removal to reseal.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Remove front aerodynamic belly pan and inspect with UV light for gear oil residue.

chronic_issues.symptoms: Sweet maple syrup odor after hard driving; gradual loss of coolant level in expansion tank.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Check upper plastic seam of tank located in the left rear engine compartment for white chalky residue.

chronic_issues.component: LDF Transmission Clutch Pack Wear (Launch Counter)
chronic_issues.symptoms: Clutch hesitation in 1st/reverse, jerky low-speed maneuvering.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Demand dealer ODIS / Leonardo diagnostic report showing exact launch control count and clutch touch point millimeter wear.

chronic_issues.symptoms: Hissing behind dashboard vents; AC blows warm air despite refrigerant recharge.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Requires full interior dashboard removal. Sniff air vents immediately upon AC startup.

must_have_options.name: Front Suspension Lifting System
must_have_options.description: Non-negotiable. The long front overhang will scrape on 90% of driveways without hydraulic lift.

must_have_options.name: Carbon Fiber Exterior Lower & Upper Packages
must_have_options.description: Front spoiler, rear diffuser, side intake scoops in genuine glossy carbon fiber.

must_have_options.name: T-Shaped Engine Cover & X-Frame in Carbon
must_have_options.description: Structural aesthetic carbon reinforcement across the mid-mounted V12.

must_have_options.name: Sensonum Premium Audio System
must_have_options.description: Better acoustic output, although most buyers listen to the 8,250 RPM V12 sound.

chronic_issues.symptoms: Clutch slippage in Corsa mode, gear engagement fault warning on dashboard, smell of burning friction material.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: MANDATORY: Run a Lamborghini Lara/Leonardo diagnostic tool check. A clutch reading below 25% requires an immediate $20,000 price deduction because the engine must be pulled out.

chronic_issues.symptoms: Clunking or rattling noise over expansion joints; unequal ride height.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Inspect pushrod horizontal spring mounts and check for oil weeping along damper shaft.

chronic_issues.component: Fuel Tank Evaporative Vent System (Recall Campaign)
chronic_issues.symptoms: Fuel vapors venting near hot exhaust in high RPM over-rev, fire hazard with aftermarket catless pipes.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Verify official Lamborghini Safety Recall L616 (EVAP canister & purge valve update) was completed in authorized service records.

chronic_issues.component: Scissor Door Hydraulic Lift Gas Struts
chronic_issues.symptoms: Scissor doors fail to stay elevated or feel overly heavy to open.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Open both doors and let go at 45 degrees. They should glide smoothly upward without assistance.

urus_suv.name: Lamborghini Urus (4.0L Twin-Turbo V8)
urus_suv.drivetrain: All-Wheel Drive with Active Rear Torque Vectoring

must_have_options.name: Bang & Olufsen 3D Advanced Sound System
must_have_options.description: 21 speakers with motorized acoustic acoustic tweeters. Massive resale appeal.

must_have_options.name: 23-inch Taigete / Pelope Diamond Finished Wheels
must_have_options.description: The 21-inch base wheels make the Urus look under-wheeled; 23-inch is the market standard.

must_have_options.name: Panoramic Glass Electric Sunroof
must_have_options.description: Cabin airiness and family utility demand.

must_have_options.name: Full ADAS Safety Suite (Highway & Urban Package)
must_have_options.description: Adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, 360 top-view 3D camera.

chronic_issues.component: 4.0T V8 Turbo Coolant Line O-Rings & Plastic Y-Connectors
chronic_issues.symptoms: Coolant pooling in engine V valley, low coolant level warning.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Inspect the inner engine V under the plastic cover with a borescope for pink crust.

chronic_issues.component: Carbon Ceramic Brake Squeal at Low Speeds
chronic_issues.symptoms: High-pitched screeching during light braking in city traffic.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Check pad chamfer and ensure dealer anti-squeal damping plates are installed.

chronic_issues.component: Air Suspension Compressor Valve Block Sticking
chronic_issues.symptoms: One corner sits 1-2 inches lower after standing overnight; compressor runs excessively.
chronic_issues.inspection_tip: Measure ground clearance on all 4 corners after vehicle has been parked for 24 hours.
